name: Brandes et al. 2023 against ProteinGym clinical on ESM-1b and EVE: explained by global against per-gene AUC

attributes.rationale: The two sides use different metrics, and the developers say so. Brandes et al. 2023 rank by global ROC-AUC across all ClinVar missense variants, and their Methods state that EVE is somewhat superior according to the gene-average ROC-AUC (Extended Data Fig. 1b) and that ESM1b performs slightly worse on a gene-specific ROC-AUC. ProteinGym's clinical benchmark (performance_clinical_benchmarks.py) computes AUC per gene and then averages; on its 2,525 clinical genes EVE averages 0.914 against 0.892 for ESM-1b and wins 884 genes against 603. The reversal is the global against per-gene average difference, not an error on either side. No outreach needed.
